landing.title: Donate Blood, Save Lives in Angola
landing.subtitle: Every day hundreds of Angolans need blood transfusions due to accidents, surgeries, childbirths and treatment of diseases like malaria, sickle cell anemia and other pathologies.
landing.description: Being a blood donor in Angola is an act of solidarity that saves lives. The process is safe, quick and essential for our healthcare system.

01.title: Reception and Registration
01.description: The donor is registered at the Blood Bank based on presenting an official photo identification document (identity card, CPTS, driver's license, etc.).

02.title: Clinical Screening
02.description: After registration, the donor is directed to a location where an individual and confidential questionnaire about their health will be conducted to assess if they are fit to donate.

03.title: Collection
03.description: Performed by trained health professionals, and the material used is single-use, sterile and disposable. Each donation collects approximately 450 ml of blood.

04.title: Snack
04.description: After collection, the donor is directed to our cafeteria where they receive a tasty snack to replenish their energy.

05.title: After Donation
05.description: Serological tests for transmissible diseases and blood typing are performed. After approval, the blood is separated into 4 components: platelets, red blood cells, plasma and cryoprecipitate.

06.title: Test Results
06.description: After 7 days of your donation, you can collect your donor card with the test results directly at the Blood Bank.

how_updated.title: How is Stock Updated?
how_updated.description: Our stock is updated in real-time with each donation received and each blood unit used in transfusions in Angolan hospitals. The data reflect the exact situation at the time of consultation throughout the national territory.

critical_meaning.title: What Does "Critical Level" Mean?
critical_meaning.description: Critical level means we have fewer units than the minimum recommended to meet medical emergencies in Angola. In these cases, we urgently need donors to avoid blood shortages in our hospitals.

sobre.title: About Us
sobre.subtitle: We are the National Blood Institute of Angola, committed to the safe collection, processing and distribution of blood to save Angolan lives.
sobre.mission_text: Ensure equitable and safe access to blood and its components, contributing to the improvement of healthcare in Angola.
sobre.vision_text: To be a national reference in haemotherapy, recognised for excellence, innovation and positive impact on Angolan public health.
sobre.values_text: Solidarity, quality, integrity and innovation guide every action of our Institute.
sobre.history_p1: The National Blood Institute of Angola was founded with the mission of ensuring safe and equitable access to blood throughout the national territory. Since our founding, we have worked tirelessly to build a robust network for blood collection and distribution.
sobre.history_p2: Over the years, we have expanded our network to cover all 18 provinces of Angola, establishing partnerships with hospitals, clinics and health centres across the country.
sobre.history_p3: Today, we are recognised as a reference institution in the haemotherapy sector in Angola, with a modern stock management system and a digital platform that facilitates the donation process.
highlights: Founded in 2003 to meet the growing need for safe blood
Expansion to all 18 provinces of Angola
More than 10,000 donors registered on the platform
Partnership with more than 50 hospitals across the country

values.solidarity_desc: We believe that each donation is an act of solidarity that saves lives.
values.quality_desc: We guarantee the highest quality standards in all our processes.
values.integrity_desc: We act with transparency and responsibility in all our actions.
values.innovation_desc: We continuously invest in technology to improve our services.

sobre.what_we_do_subtitle: We work at every stage of the blood cycle to ensure safety and availability for Angolan patients.

services.collection_desc: We organise campaigns and receive donors in all our units in Angola.
services.screening_desc: All blood is tested to ensure safety before transfusion.
services.distribution_desc: We distribute blood to hospitals and clinics throughout the national territory.
services.campaigns_desc: We run awareness campaigns to increase the number of donors.
services.platform_desc: We offer a digital platform to facilitate scheduling and manage donations.
services.training_desc: We train health professionals in haemotherapy and best transfusion practices.
